Playwright's locator.boundingBox() returns {x,y,width,height} with no right property; Math.round(undefined) is NaN and NaN <= n silently fails soft assertions — compute x + width instead (fixed at tests/sprint-05-orient-search/token-presentation.spec.ts:587).

The no-JS page-wide overflow check cannot use evaluate (hangs with JavaScript disabled, the ORI-CONT-005 finding), so the no-JS branch asserts box-based containment via boundingBox while the JS-enabled projects assert the exact 0px scrollWidth (tests/sprint-05-orient-search/token-presentation.spec.ts:575-597).
Before probing localhost:4321 by hand, check the listener's cwd via lsof -p <pid> — sibling worktree servers are visually identical but serve their own dist.
